reasoning: The icon shows an eight-pointed starburst badge containing an exclamation mark, representing an alert, warning, or expiring/invalidated certificate. While urgency itself is a task property rather than a subject, this glyph fits tasks whose literal subject is a system alert, incident, recall notice, or certificate expiration. It closely resembles circular or triangular warning icons as well as verification badges.
